  claim is independently checkable rather than asserted.
- README.md: fully qualify the GPG-extension path
  (~/.punt-labs/ethos/identities/<handle>.ext/beadle.yaml) to match
  the identity YAML path on the line above, removing the relative-path
  ambiguity Copilot flagged.

The fourth comment (.punt-labs/ethos/ethos.yaml duplicating the
repo-root .punt-labs/ethos.yaml) is dismissed, not fixed: verified
internal/identity/resolve.go's resolveHandle only ever reads
filepath.Join(r.repoDir, ".punt-labs", "ethos.yaml") — the repo-root
file — never .punt-labs/ethos/ethos.yaml, so the inner file is inert.
It's deposited automatically by `ethos enable` as part of the standard
vendored-copy convention; lux's .punt-labs/ethos/ethos.yaml has
identical content (agent: claude), confirming this isn't specific to
this PR. Removing it would just have it redeposited on the next
`ethos enable`.
EOF
)"
git push 2>&1
